name: Suraj Prakash
description: Suraj Prakash is a product manager, AI platform builder and AdTech and MarTech researcher based in Kuala Lumpur. Six years building B2B SaaS at Moving Walls, AI-powered applications designed and deployed hands-on, and independent research on AdTech, MarTech, OOH and DOOH.

pillars.title: Product thinking
pillars.body: Six years at Moving Walls across five roles, most recently owning strategy, roadmap and delivery for its programmatic DOOH platform.

pillars.title: Industry intelligence
pillars.body: Sixteen independent research papers on how advertising is bought, measured and proved, collected in the first edition of Media Intelligence.

pillars.title: Technology execution
pillars.body: Two AI-powered products taken from requirement to live production on my own, one of them in 15 days.

headline: Product manager · AI platform builder · B2B SaaS · AdTech & MarTech researcher
